system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Veiled Moon abilities, and you must receive training from another Eclipse Walker, or have access to their teachings

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

You are half-in, half-out of the spirit world, nearly becoming a spirit yourself.

As an Action, you can take on the form of a spirit.

  • Your Soul increases by +2

  • Any attacks you make gain the Magical and Penetrating traits

  • You take half Damage from non-magical attacks

  • You can move through hostile creature's spaces in combat without needing to make a Dexterity check

  • Once per turn, when you would be affected by a spell or magical effect, you can negate the effect as a Free Action

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, other followers of the Path of the Veiled Moon will recognize your skill and afford you special respect.
